kindHint.cash_allowance: Money paid with the salary, as a line on the payslip.
kindHint.in_kind_credit: Points added to the employee's own member wallet.
kindHint.entitlement: Recorded for its cost only — insurance cover, a membership.

benefits.description: Every benefit: what it is, how often it is granted and what it is worth. Open one to give it to employees, grades and units.
benefits.fixedOnceCreated: The code, kind, frequency, currency and pay component are fixed once the benefit exists.
benefits.payComponentHint: An earning worked out as "Benefit allowance" and on every payslip. Add one under pay components if none is offered.
benefits.endOfPeriod: At the end of the period
benefits.walletHint: General points never expire. An employee with no member wallet cannot receive points; the grant fails and can be retried once they have one.
benefits.costCurrencyNeeded: Choose the currency of the cost.
benefits.daysOfService: {n} day of service | {n} days of service
benefits.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? A benefit already granted cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.subtitle: Who the benefit is given to, and from when
assignments.hint: Where several assignments reach an employee, the most specific decides: their own, then their grade's, then their nearest unit's.
assignments.amountHint: Leave empty to give the benefit's own value.
assignments.excluded: Take the benefit away from this employee
assignments.excludedHint: Their own assignment decides for them, so they lose a benefit their grade or unit gives.
assignments.endHint: An assignment ends earlier, never later; add a new one to extend it.
assignments.deleteConfirm: Delete this assignment? One with grants under it cannot be deleted; end it instead.

grants.title: Grants
grants.description: Every benefit granted, newest first. A daily job grants each month's benefits; grant now to do it at once for a month.
grants.runHint: Grants the month's benefits now rather than waiting for the daily job. Safe to repeat: an employee is granted a period once.
grants.cancelConfirm: Cancel this grant? It has not been delivered.

held.title: Benefits held
held.subtitle: On the date chosen, and where each comes from

cost.description: Each employee's full cost for a month: the employer cost of their approved payroll and of their benefits, by currency.
cost.empty: No approved payroll or benefits in this month.

mine.description: Your benefits today and what you have been granted. Wallet points land on your member wallet.
mine.none: You have no benefits at the moment.
